football_evidence.question: Can North Texas’ pass rush get to Caden Veltkamp?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward North Texas, and its own breakdown accounts for about 1.1 of the 2.8 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When North Texas has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): North Texas’ offense has allowed a sack on 1.9% of its dropbacks, and Florida Atlantic’s defense sacks the quarterback on 5.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When North Texas has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): North Texas’ offense averages 10.2 yards per pass attempt, and Florida Atlantic’s defense allows 8.8 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).
When North Texas has the ball (the run game against the run defense): North Texas’ offense averages 6.0 yards per carry, and Florida Atlantic’s defense allows 7.4 yards per carry (FBS average 5.1).

When North Texas has the ball (big plays through the air): North Texas’ offense turns 15.7% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Florida Atlantic’s defense gives up explosive gains on 12.4% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).
contradicting: When Florida Atlantic has the ball (third down): Florida Atlantic’s offense converts 51.7% of its third downs, and North Texas’ defense allows opponents to convert 37.5% of their third downs (FBS average 39.5%).

When Florida Atlantic has the ball (the red zone): Florida Atlantic’s offense succeeds on 49.9% of its red-zone plays, and North Texas’ defense allows success on 53.2% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
In his last two games (houstonchristian and Charlotte), Ditta averaged 7.8 yards per attempt, against 17.0 in his two games before that.

When Florida Atlantic has the ball (down-to-down efficiency): Florida Atlantic’s offense succeeds on 48.4% of its offensive plays, and North Texas’ defense allows opponents to succeed on 43.0% of their plays (FBS average 42.3%).
quarterbacks: Tayven Jackson has completed 159 of 220 passes (72.3%) for 2,144 yards, 9.7 yards per attempt, 17 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in seven games for North Texas, and has been sacked on 4 of 224 dropbacks.
Chaston Ditta has completed 15 of 20 passes (75.0%) for 183 yards, 9.2 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and no interceptions in four games for North Texas, and has been sacked on 2 of 22 dropbacks.

Caden Veltkamp has completed 191 of 260 passes (73.5%) for 2,164 yards, 8.3 yards per attempt, 18 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in seven games for Florida Atlantic, and has been sacked on 13 of 273 dropbacks.
